purpose: Unified qualification evidence index across adversarial, positive-boundary, mixed holdout, final unseen holdout, and post-remediation known regression cases. Source case definitions remain authoritative in their original datasets.
important_interpretation: Original first-run dispositions are immutable historical evidence. Later regression success does not rewrite an earlier failure or convert remediated evidence into fresh unseen evidence. KNOWN_REGRESSION_CASE denotes a case authored after the relevant holdout failure and is not an unseen first-run disposition.
